description.narrative: Provide Chamroeun with Technical Assistance (TA) aimed at better understanding the PWO market and landscape and developing case studies of selected PWOs to help inform the development of the loan product/s that will be offered to these SMEs, the risk-return structure and the de-risking requirements for these loans. These research/studies are likewise expected to provide insights on the intended outcomes and social impact from the collaboration. The estimated budget for the conduct of the researches is a maximum of US Dollars 20,000.

mailing-address.narrative: #425 St.271, Sangkat Toul Tom Pong II, Khan Chamka mon, Phnom Penh, Yothapol Khemarak Phoumin Boulevard, Phnom Penh, Cambodia

title.narrative: Please provide a short narrative explanation of the data here. (max 250 words)

actual.value:
According to Chamroeun’s database, there were 11 PWOs in the pipelines, of which 5 obtained loans as of August 2024 with a total amount of US$320,000 and an average loan size of US$80,000 and with 5-year loan tenor. Demand for around US$465,000 from other 7 PWOs were rejected due to poor profile or credibility with the Credit Bureau of Cambodia (CBC), limited repayment capacity, and/or old age of borrowers[PP1] . The number is far below the target of 20 PWOs to be financed by the end of project period (December 2024). Although only 11 PWOs requested loans from Chamroeun, many PWOs have been reached out through iSEA and Cambodia Water Supply Association (CWA) and therefore they are aware of the PWO loans provided by Chamroeun. Given higher interest rate from microfinance institutions (MFIs) than banks,[PP2] it is believed that it is very difficult for Chamroeun to penetrate the market for WASH sector.
[PP1]May be good to mention that these PWOs are primarily individuals, as context for the reader. Otherwise old age seems like the operating history of the PWO
[PP2]Is it possible to give a comparison of the rates offered?
